churn.title: Churn Rate
churn.definition: The percentage of customers who stop using your product during a specific timeframe.
churn.trade_off: High growth is offset by high churn; focus on retention to build a 'compound interest' engine.

cac.title: Customer Acquisition Cost
cac.definition: The total cost of winning a customer to purchase a product or service.
cac.formula: Total Marketing + Sales Expenses / New Customers Acquired
cac.trade_off: Lowering CAC increases profitability but might limit scale if you only target 'cheap' channels.

ltv.title: Lifetime Value
ltv.definition: The total revenue a business can expect from a single customer account throughout the business relationship.
ltv.formula: Average Purchase Value * Number of Purchases * Average Customer Lifespan
ltv.trade_off: Increasing LTV usually requires increasing Trust and product quality, which costs Health and Morale.

aov.title: Average Order Value
aov.definition: The average amount of money each customer spends per transaction.
aov.trade_off: Raising AOV (e.g., upselling) can boost immediate revenue but might damage Trust if the value isn't perceived.

tech_debt.title: Technical Debt
tech_debt.definition: The implied cost of additional rework caused by choosing an easy (fast) solution now instead of using a better approach that would take longer.
tech_debt.formula: Cost of Change (Future) - Cost of Change (Now)
tech_debt.trade_off: Speed now vs. Stability later. Excessive debt leads to outages and Team Mutiny.

conversion.title: Conversion Rate
conversion.definition: The percentage of visitors who complete a desired goal (a purchase) out of the total number of visitors.
conversion.trade_off: Removing friction (e.g., Guest Checkout) boosts conversion but might lower data quality or LTV.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.definition: The total volume of users visiting your platform.
traffic.formula: Sum of all unique daily visitors.
traffic.trade_off: High traffic is a vanity metric if conversion is broken. Quality over quantity.

revenue.title: Net Revenue
revenue.definition: The total income generated by the business from its core operations.
revenue.trade_off: Short-term revenue spikes often come at the cost of Trust or Morale (e.g., Aggressive upselling).
